rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=20, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=8, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=3, unet_c=24, rationale=iter-2: KNOB=pretrain_lr 2e-4->1e-3 (5x up). iter-1 val_score 0.3429 (val_psnr 11.1 dB) — sibling itnet=0.9729, v3=0.9683, and v2's OWN phase4 history hit 0.9714, all at pretrain_lr=1e-3. iter-1's 2e-4 is 5x below that proven optimum, so with only 8 epochs + patience=5 early-stop the residual denoiser barely moves off FBP-init (hence near-FBP psnr). Hypothesis: restoring pretrain_lr=1e-3 lets the U-Net actually fit the FBP->truth residual within 8 epochs and closes most of the 0.34->0.97 gap; if still short, next iter raises pretrain_epochs.
